text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] eu-west-2 probe cluster: multiple health-check heartbeats missed (count=4) — paging on-call

oncall-jordan: seeing the page, starting triage. anyone else seeing alerts?

sre-maya: yep, alerts bubbled in. dashboards show probe success rate dropping from 99.9% -> ~65% around 08:13 UTC. latency graphs look noisy.

netops-liam: I've got the synthetic probe logs — they show 504s and timeouts, but also a bunch of empty responses with zero bytes. suspect something at the routing layer (ALB/NLB) or a downstream control-plane gateway.

oncall-jordan: good call. checking route53 healthchecks and our internal probe mesh. route53 shows healthcheck failures for eu-west-2 endpoints, but cross-region probes (us-west) still ok.

pm-anya: cx impacted? any customer reports?

sre-maya: SaaS metrics: small uptick in API 502s proxied from inference gateway in eu-west-2, but only for <1% of requests. Most traffic routed to fallback region as expected. No major error spike in usage dashboards.

netops-liam: running quick traceroute from eu-west-2 probe hosts to target nodes... intermittent packet loss at hop-4, seems to align with cloud provider NVA IP range.

oncall-jordan: are monitoring probes sending heartbeats? I'm seeing telemetry gaps in our ingestion for the cluster — last telemetry at 08:12 UTC, then a 7m silence. Could be our collector or the probe instances themselves.

sre-maya: i'll query the collector logs: `kubectl logs -n telemetry collector-0 --since=10m`

oncall-jordan: putting a short-lived suppression on pager for eu-west-2 probe-health to avoid pager storm while we investigate. Will not suppress customer-facing alerts.

incident-bot: Pager suppression applied by oncall-jordan for 15m on channel eng-oncall (reason: investigation in-progress) :white_circle:

netops-liam: collector logs show connection resets from the probe agents, stack traces indicating TLS handshakes failing intermittently. Could be a mid-path device performing TLS inspection/dropping.

oncall-jordan: hmm. cloud-support-bot, can you run a healthcheck of the VPC NAT gateways and the AZ control plane for eu-west-2?

cloud-support-bot: Submitted support ticket to provider (case 123456789). Provider acknowledges increased control-plane retries in eu-west-2 at 08:10 UTC, investigating.

pm-anya: we've only had 2 customers ping support with minor latency complaints. I'll flag this to account execs and keep them updated that we have fallback and no broad impact yet.

sre-maya: mitigation checklist: 1) confirm probe agents are alive 2) switch probe region routing to use cross-region collectors temporarily 3) verify no config rollout happened around 08:00 that could cause TLS mismatches

oncall-jordan: checking deployments — no rollout at 08:00 in telemetry or probe agents.

netops-liam: I can flip probe endpoint targets to a proxy in us-east-1 to validate whether local routing is the issue. That would give us telemetry continuity but might skew latency numbers. Need approval.

oncall-jordan: go ahead, do a small Canary by re-pointing 10% of probes to cross-region collector. Post the command when ready.

netops-liam: running:```bash
# re-route 10% of probe traffic to cross-region collector
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://ops-api.internal/v1/probes/reroute \
  -d '{"region":"eu-west-2","percent":10,"target":"collector-useast1"}'
```

netops-liam: Canary applied. New probe successes starting at 08:22 UTC for the canary set. Collector ingestion from canary looks healthy.

sre-maya: great. that confirms probe agents and collector code are ok. likely a regional networking/control-plane problem. we should expand canary to 50% to restore visibility while provider investigates.

oncall-jordan: agree. ramping to 50%. keeping 50% local so we can still measure delta.

incident-bot: User oncall-jordan escalated suppression to 45m (reason: extended investigation) :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

cloud-support-bot: Provider update: noise in control plane causing intermittent packet drops for internal LB in eu-west-2. ETA unknown. Suggested customers route traffic to other AZs or regions.

pm-anya: creating customer advisory draft saying limited probe telemetry in eu-west-2 may cause false-positive monitoring. recommending customers rely on our cross-region fallback and no immediate action required.

oncall-jordan: NOTE: do not change DNS TTLs or DNS records unless directed. We should avoid global churn. We can control probe routing without TTL changes.

netops-liam: expanding canary to 50% now:```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://ops-api.internal/v1/probes/reroute \
  -d '{"region":"eu-west-2","percent":50,"target":"collector-useast1"}'
```

netops-liam: done. ingestion stable for the 50%. local probes still flaky but partial telemetry restored.

sre-maya: runbook update: mark this as "regional control-plane packet loss causing probe heartbeats to fail" and set post-incident action item to add extra probe collectors in-region and cross-region fallback automation.

oncall-jordan: agree. also add an alert to detect telemetry ingestion silence vs probe failures — we had both and they confused the triage. need a detector for ingestion-channel gaps.

cloud-support-bot: Provider message: ongoing. They plan to divert control-plane traffic around the affected fabric by 09:15 UTC. We'll monitor.

pm-anya: sending advisory to impacted customers now, keep me posted on timeline to close the advisory.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] eu-west-2 provider status changed: partial remediation in control plane routing. Continue to monitor.

netops-liam: I'm seeing reappearance of local probe successes after 09:12 UTC. Good sign. collector ingress latency is back to normal.

sre-maya: pulling a quick regression eval between 08:00-09:30 to confirm no quality regressions on inference outputs due to failover. so far looks clean (no model-level errors).

oncall-jordan: removing pager suppression in 10m. will leave routing changes in place until midnight UTC to ensure stability.

incident-bot: Pager suppression expired (oncall-jordan) — the channel will resume normal paging. :white_check_mark:

pm-anya: advisory sent and updated: false-positive-like telemetry gap detected in eu-west-2; mitigation in place; customers routed to fallback; no broad customer impact.

oncall-jordan: postmortem owners? suggest netops-liam and sre-maya to lead, PM anya to own customer communications notes. Action items: 1) add ingestion-silence detector 2) automate probe reroute to cross-region collector 3) add runbook section for provider control-plane incidents.

sre-maya: ack. I'll create the postmortem doc and include timeline + logs + provider ticket ID.

netops-liam: will follow up with provider for deeper routing traces and request a post-incident RCA.

pm-anya: thanks all — closing coordination here, ping me if you need me to re-open the advisory.

oncall-jordan: thanks team.
